The numeric settings are also rendered into the prompt text.","CP":"update_config commits the config values to the FinBotConfig database row. The row is read on every request to build the system prompt, so the attacker's settings persist across sessions until reset. This is durable standing behaviour, not just re-retrieval of source content.","AP":"The weakened configuration affects every later invoice decision made by the same agent under the same principal and policy domain. It can also be steered by attacker-supplied config, and detect_fraud_patterns returns an empty result when the flag is off. No verified reward-hacking episodes are reported, so the classification is Possible. The locus is the environment, because the weakened controls live in the config row, not in a separate grader.","ES":"There are five fixed tools defined in code, with no dynamic tools, MCP servers, plugins or skills.
